content:
Date: Tuesday, June 23, 2026

Selected Approach:
- New shared theme/_form-fields.scss partial, applied scoped, with <ion-input> converted to native <input class="field-input">

Approved implementation approach:
Create a single theme/_form-fields.scss that mirrors the canonical onboarding .field-label / .field-input values using FRED palette literals (#2563EB, #0f172a, #6b7280, red error) — not the kyc-scoped --kyc-* vars. On each of the 7 target pages, convert the inputs to native <label class="field-label"> + <input class="field-input"> for a true pixel match, and @use the partial scoped under each page's root selector (not a blanket global rule) so My Profile's .field-label div and the onboarding components are provably untouched. Carry over focus + error/validation treatment to match onboarding.

Andrew's Answers:
Q: From the story — are the search + chat inputs in scope? AC-6 leaves two controls pending your call: the <ion-searchbar> search fields (e.g. stock selection) and the ai-chat <ion-textarea> composer. They're a search control and a chat composer, not data-entry form fields, so my recommendation is to exclude both — restyling them as underline fields would look wrong and risk regressions outside the 25-field set. Required
  A (Andrew confirmed your prediction): Exclude both — leave the ion-searchbar and the ai-chat textarea composer as they are. Just the 25 form fields across the 7 listed pages.
Q: Scoped application vs a blanket global rule. The canonical classes (.field-input/.field-label) are also used by out-of-scope surfaces — I confirmed My Profile uses .field-label and onboarding defines both. So Option A applies the shared partial scoped to the 7 target pages rather than as a one-line global import (Option C), to provably keep My Profile/onboarding untouched. Confirming you're fine trading a little extra per-page wiring for that safety. Optional
  A (Andrew confirmed your prediction): Yes — apply it scoped to the 7 pages, don't make it global. Keeping My Profile and onboarding provably untouched is worth the extra wiring.

Proceed with implementation.
